collection.name: You Are ATM
collection.description: The face of a movement. The fuel for what's next. 'You Are ATM' is the official NFT collection commemorating a turning point in the $ATM journey — the moment our community became the CTO.  Backed by Ripple recognition and powered by the people, this collection marks the rise of a decentralized force driving the future of XRPL culture. Each NFT will support the ATM liquidity pool, CTO efforts and permanently stamps your role in the story — not as a bystander, but as the engine. This is a signal. A nod from Brad Garlinghouse. A shift in power. A new era. Own your piece. Be the protocol. You Are ALL THE MONEY!
